title: Remove Diagnostics open history flat export
summary: Moved Command History's Diagnostics open-history handoff to the mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView namespace and removed the transitional renderDiagnosticsOpenHistory flat window export.
reason: Continue reducing WebView flat compatibility exports by touched Diagnostics/Command History domain while preserving command evidence rendering and backend-owned mutation boundaries.
behavior_before: diagnosticsView.js exposed renderDiagnosticsOpenHistory both through window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView and as window.renderDiagnosticsOpenHistory, and Command History called the flat global when propagating command evidence.
behavior_after: Command History invokes a namespace-backed Diagnostics open-history helper, diagnosticsView.js keeps renderDiagnosticsOpenHistory only on window.mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView, and static/smoke coverage rejects the flat assignment/caller path.
tests_added: Updated LocalApiServerTests.test_local_api_serves_read_only_web_prototype to assert Command History uses the namespace-backed helper and diagnosticsView.js does not assign window.renderDiagnosticsOpenHistory.
Updated test_webview_command_evidence_smoke to require and invoke mediaPipelineDiagnosticsView.renderDiagnosticsOpenHistory instead of the flat renderer.
manual_validation: .\apps\desktop\runtime\Python\python.exe -B -m unittest tests.webview.test_webview_browser_diagnostics_handoff_smoke -q (passes with the existing malformed broken-active-job.json warning)
rollback_plan: Restore the window.renderDiagnosticsOpenHistory assignment in diagnosticsView.js, move Command History and its smoke back to the flat renderer if required, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline and summaries, and restore the flat-export counts/inventory entry.
notes:
Moved Diagnostics open-history rendering from the flat global to a namespace-backed helper.
Removed the legacy renderDiagnosticsOpenHistory flat export while retaining the namespace member.
Updated static coverage for namespace-based Diagnostics open-history rendering and absence of the flat assignment.
Moved command evidence smoke expectations and calls to the Diagnostics namespace renderer.
Updated the tracked WebView flat-export count after the Diagnostics open-history cleanup.
Updated the Diagnostics flat-export inventory and total.
Regenerated the WebView public contract baseline after removing the flat open-history renderer export.
